description: Generate one or more images from a text prompt. Returns URLs (one per line). Pass image_urls to edit or condition on reference images. Models with an edit variant switch to it automatically; models without reference support return a clear 400. Use list_models with type=image for available models and prices (references may carry a per-image surcharge). The last line is cost_usd: the exact amount charged.

image_urls.description: Reference image URLs for editing / img2img conditioning

model.description: Image model slug, e.g. openai/gpt-image-2 or black-forest-labs/flux-2

n.description: Number of images (billed per image), default 1

quality.description: Quality tier where the model supports it (xhigh and max: gpt-image-2.5 only); affects price on tiered models

name: generate_image
title: Generate an image
